page.layout: One printed page, full width: page number top left; running head none; four tabular diagrams (Tabula XI, XII, XIII, XIV) with braces, each read as an outline, from top to bottom. A small catchword/tag "TA" at the bottom right edge is cut off from the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.head: TABVLA XI.
main_text.l: Sterilis, vt vlmus, alnus, tilia, buxus, salix, populus.
Nobilior: Cinnamomum, quod habet corticem eiusdem nominis, cassia.
Minus nobilis: Corylus, sambucus, rosa, rubus, &c.
main_text.head: TABVLA XII.
main_text.l: 1. Frumentacea: Triticum, hordeum, spelta, siligo, avena.
2. Portulaca, malua, porrum, petroselinum, rapa, brassica capitata.
Aromatica: Crocus, zingiber, acorus, zedoaria, calamus aromaticus.
main_text.head: TABVLA XIII.
main_text.l: Rationale: Homo reliquarum substantiarum simulacrum & medium, μιxεξικοσμος.
Secundariae: insecta, apes, scarabaei, crabrones, vespae, cantharides, muscae.
Ruminantes: vt sunt cornutae, bos, cervus, capra.
Mixtae siue amphibia, quae terrae & aquae natae, vt, rana, crocodilus, testudines, lacertae, serpentes.
main_text.head: TABVLA XIV.
main_text.l: Proprie dicta, quae est extensio solius corporis, eaque vel
Completa, Trina dimensio, Mathematice corpus: quod vel
Regulare, bases, latera, angulos aequales, simi-esque habens
Pyramis, Cubus seu hexaedron, Octahedron, Dodecahedron, Icosahedron.
Asser, Laterculus, Cuneolus, Prisma, Conus, Cylindrus.
Continuatio quaevis rei, vt in tempore continuatio durationis,
Extensio gradualis, quae intensio dicitur, Sic calor dicitur calor maior vel minor,
Quantitate discreta, seu numero, Vide Tab.16.

page.notes: The page is a printed table of diagrams; the brace layouts are rendered as indented outline levels. Some right-margin lines run off the scan edge and may be cut short. The Greek word in Tabula XIII (μιxεξικοσμος) and the Greek in Tabula XIV are uncertain and may be misprinted. Reading of small type is approximate in places.
